data.title: ExxonMobil to Release Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
data.description: In Spring, Texas, ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation (NYSE: XOM) is set to disclose its third quarter 2026 financial outcomes on Friday, October 30, 2026. The corporation will publish a press statement using Business Wire, accessible at 5:30 a.m. CT on investor.exxonmobil.com. Leading figures like Darren Woods, Chairman and CEO; Neil Hansen, Senior VP and CFO; and Jim Chapman, VP of Corporate Finance and Treasurer, will examine the results during the event.

data.title: Mercedes-Benz USA Reports Quarterly Passenger Car Sales Growth of 4%
data.description: In Atlanta, Mercedes-Benz USA (MBUSA) announced a 4% increase in third-quarter passenger car sales compared to Q3 2025, selling 76,200 vehicles. Additionally, 9,600 vans were delivered, bringing total retail sales for the quarter to 85,800 units, a 3% increase. The growth was driven by high demand for Mercedes-Benz SUVs, Core vehicles, and Top-End vehicles. The Alabama-produced GLE contributed to the strong momentum.

data.title: Bitcoin treasury giant's strategy at risk as MSCI rules will exclude "non-operating companies" like it, beginning Nov. 30 due to asset-heavy balance sheets.
data.description: Starting on November 30th, the index provider will deem companies that are primarily characterized as "non-operating," or those whose financial statements are predominantly reliant on a single asset, as ineligible. This decision aims to address firms that do not meet operational standards within the index.

data.title: SpaceX Earnings Due Amid AI Revenue Surge, Tesla Merger Buzz
data.description: On Tuesday night, SpaceX is scheduled to release its earnings report, with analysts anticipating the company to post its first-ever adjusted profit. Investors are closely watching for any updates on a potential merger with Tesla. The earnings release comes amid a significant surge in revenue from AI-related projects.
